name: ClosedSchool
source:
Kousuke, Saina and Ritsune are ordinary high schoolers.

"Hey, did you hear that a student went missing at our school?"

The friends investigate the rumor for personal entertainment.
But when they find the missing student's corpse, the fun is over,
and whimsical interest becomes a very real, very dangerous
search for the truth.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ181816.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Kousuke、Saina和Ritsune是普通的高中生。

“喂，你听说了吗？我们学校有个学生失踪了。”

几个朋友为了找乐子，开始调查这则传闻。
然而，当他们发现失踪学生的尸体时，一切就再也不好玩了。
原本一时兴起的好奇，变成了一场真实而危险的真相追寻。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ181816.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
